## Summary

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually executed, their results, and any unexecuted backend tests.

## Security and compatibility

Describe authorization, secret handling, database, migration, and release impact.
Include a changelog fragment for runtime changes. Use sanitized diagnostics only.

## Release readiness

List remaining blockers or required administrator settings. Native auto-merge
requires protected-branch checks and resolved conversations; never fabricate reviews.
